title: Renewal #1 - VIEWPOINT & M-ARIS Maintenance & Service
agency_path: City of New York > Police Department
description_text:
NYPD will continue to receive Maintenance & Support Service for ViewPoint and M-ARIS Systems at NYPD's Counter Terrorism Bureau. These services are offered directly as a Sole Source by Thermo Eberline LLC - DCMB# 177-22-0149
Original Contract: EPIN# 05623S0008001 , CT1-056-20248803903 with Two 2-Year Renewal Options. NYPD is excersing the first 2-Year renewal option per DCMB# #177-26-0134

The sole source method is the most competitive method that is appropriate under the circumstances since there is only one source available
